title: Panic of 1837
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Panic of 1837", at revision 1375138703, opens: "The Panic of 1837 was a financial crisis in the United States that began a major depression which lasted until the mid-1840s. Profits, prices, and wages dropped, westward expansion was stalled, unemployment rose, and pessimism abounded." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2092480, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "financial crisis in the United States". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
